title: Insert Table Row (Tables)

scenarios.title: Insert Table Row applies its documented behavior
scenarios.expected: Insert Table Row (BtnTableRowInsertion) is invoked on the documented fixture deck and produces its documented effect on the selection or presentation, leaves no new entry in %TEMP%\oPenEfficiency\error_YYYYMMDD.log and does not leave PowerPoint or the add-in in an unstable state.

scenarios.title: BtnTableRowInsertion deterministic Office leg (insert above, preserve height)

requirements.text: In an isolated real PowerPoint host, the layout context-menu entry 'insert above, preserve height' on the fixture 3x3 table (interior cell selected) inserts one empty row at index 2 and scales all four rows so the total height stays the 150 pt original (37.5 pt per row), keeps the 300 pt width, the 40/40 position, the three 100 pt columns and the original texts shifted below the new empty row, reports execution, writes no new error-log entry, and tears down cleanly.

scenarios.expected: In an isolated real PowerPoint host, the layout context-menu entry 'insert above, preserve height' on the fixture 3x3 table (interior cell selected) inserts one empty row at index 2 and scales all four rows so the total height stays the 150 pt original (37.5 pt per row), keeps the 300 pt width, the 40/40 position, the three 100 pt columns and the original texts shifted below the new empty row, reports execution, writes no new error-log entry, and tears down cleanly.

done.statement: The deterministic Office leg passes against the configured build on an isolated PowerPoint host with zero new error-log entries and full teardown; bind-office-evidence-and-reviews remains until this office scenario has real-host evidence and review.

scenarios.title: BtnTableRowInsertion deterministic Office leg (duplicate row format)

requirements.text: In an isolated real PowerPoint host, the layout context-menu entry 'duplicate format above' on the fixture 3x3 table (interior cell selected, source row 2 pre-formatted red with 17 pt font) inserts an empty row at index 2 carrying the source row's 50 pt height and a full copy of its red fill and 17 pt font (the explicit fill and font copy in CopyCellFormat), leaves the original formatted row shifted to index 3 with its format intact, keeps the 100 pt columns and the 40/40 position, grows the table to 300x200, reports execution, writes no new error-log entry, and tears down cleanly.

scenarios.expected: In an isolated real PowerPoint host, the layout context-menu entry 'duplicate format above' on the fixture 3x3 table (interior cell selected, source row 2 pre-formatted red with 17 pt font) inserts an empty row at index 2 carrying the source row's 50 pt height and a full copy of its red fill and 17 pt font (PickUp/Apply plus the explicit font copy), leaves the original formatted row shifted to index 3 with its format intact, keeps the 100 pt columns and the 40/40 position, grows the table to 300x200, reports execution, writes no new error-log entry, and tears down cleanly.

done.statement: The deterministic Office leg passes against the configured build on an isolated PowerPoint host with zero new error-log entries and full teardown; bind-office-evidence-and-reviews remains until this office scenario has real-host evidence and review.
